main_text.p: Analyti-con.cap. 15. δεῖ μεταφορὰς, δῆλον ὅτι ἐὰν ὁρίζεσθαι, ὅτε μεταφορὰς. διαλέγεσθαι γὰρ ἀναγκὴν ἔσαι μεταφορᾶς.id est: si non oportet disputare metaphoris: perspicuum est, neque Metaphoris definiendum esse, neque definienda esse illa, quæcunque metaphoris exprimuntur: inquit Aristoteles. Et quoniam omnes scientiæ definitione constituuntur: (ut docet idem Aristoteles. Πάσαι αἱ ἐπιστῆμαι δι' ὁρισμῶν γίνονται, inquit:) Cùmque notionis omnis ianua & vestibulum sit definitio ἐννοηματικὴ, quam Galenus ὀνοματώδη appellat: siquidem definitio ἐννοηματικὴ lapidis philosophici à nemine adhuc tradi potuit: necesse est causas δίοτι lapidis admirabilis à nemine adhuc exponi potuisse. Nam definitio ἐννοηματικὴ nos docet ὅτι ἐςί. Sic, ubi scimus, eclipsim lunæ esse privationè lucis illius, quâ luna accipit à sole, quâdo quidè hac definitione ἐννοηματικὴ scimus ὅτι ἐςί: tu recte perquirimus διότι. Cur luna privatur luce illa, quâ accipere solet à Sole? Nempe, quia terra κατὰ διάμετρον interponitur inter

page.notes: Greek and italic passages are partly uncertain; the Greek is copied as best as legible. The word "Metaphoris" is printed as a capitalised word in the scan. The last line "inter" is set at the right margin and continues on the next page.
